item.title: Moonshot AI Opens Applications for Kimi Science Support Program
item.description:

Selected applicants receive Kimi API credits, technical support from the Kimi team, early access to new models and community resources, with top teams eligible for longer-term support.

item.title: Tec-Do and Tencent Cloud Partner on Global Marketing AI Models
item.description:
Tec-Do and Tencent Cloud signed a strategic cooperation agreement covering marketing-specific large models, compute and cloud infrastructure, MaaS services and Tencent's WorkBuddy agent ecosystem, aiming to bring AI and cloud capabilities into brands' overseas expansion. Tec-Do builds on its in-house Taiji marketing model and Navos Pro marketing multi-agent, serving users across more than 200 countries and regions.

item.title: Ant Group's Lingbo Releases LingBot-Map 2.0 and Open-Sources LingBot-Navi
item.description:
Ant Group's Lingbo Technology released LingBot-Map 2.0, a streaming 3D reconstruction model that corrects accumulated drift inside the model itself rather than relying on an external optimization backend. It also open-sourced LingBot-Navi, a navigation model that reuses 3D spatial memory across tasks to locate targets and plan routes from natural-language instructions. Model weights, technical reports and a 511-scene real-world dataset are all open-sourced.

原文标题：蚂蚁灵波发布 LingBot-Map 2.0 与 LingBot-Navi 并开源

Why it matters：直击具身智能长距离建图漂移与跨任务导航记忆两大痛点，且模型权重与数据集全面开源，对机器人研究者有直接价值。

item.title: Nadella Confirms Microsoft Has Slowed Entry-Level Hiring
item.description:
Microsoft CEO Satya Nadella acknowledged on The Pragmatic Engineer podcast that the company has slowed hiring of new graduates and junior roles, arguing AI-era firms should first redeploy existing staff and give employees AI usage quotas before adding headcount. He cautioned it is too early to call this a long-term trend and said Microsoft still values campus recruiting. Microsoft's headcount has fallen to 223,000, its first annual decline since 2016.

原文标题：纳德拉承认微软放缓应届生招聘

Why it matters：头部科技公司掌门人首次公开确认 AI 对初级岗位招聘的结构性影响，是观察 AI 就业冲击的重要产业信号。

item.title: Twenty AI Agents Team Up to Cut Quickwit Hot Query Time 31%
item.description:
TabbyML deployed a team of 20 AI agents as autonomous systems engineers on the open-source search engine Quickwit, letting them locate bottlenecks, propose designs, run experiments and review each other's code without line-level human direction. In four days the team ran roughly 350 experiments and kept 6 reviewed optimizations, cutting total hot-query time on a 100M-row dataset from 40.5s to 27.9s (down 31%, up to 87% on some queries) and surpassing all prior public results in the ClickBench data-lake hot-query ranking.

原文标题：20 个 AI Agents 组队 4 天优化 Quickwit 热查询降 31%

Why it matters：这是多智能体自主完成真实系统性能工程的少见公开实证，含完整基准数据与可复现方法。

item.title: Tencent Hunyuan Releases Hy3D 3.6 Native 3D Generation Model
item.description:
Tencent Hunyuan has released Hy3D 3.6, a next-generation native 3D generation model focused on cleaner high-poly geometry and higher-quality PBR texture generation for characters, creatures, clothing and complex props. The model is available via Tencent Cloud Token Hub API and integrated into Miora, LAP and WorkRally. The open-source Hunyuan 3D series has surpassed 6.53 million community downloads since its first release in November 2024.

item.title: Tencent Hunyuan Releases Hy3D 3.6 3D Generation Model
item.description:
Tencent Hunyuan has released Hy3D 3.6, a new-generation 3D generation model focused on high-poly modeling and PBR texture generation for professional creators such as artists, modelers, and technical artists. The native 3D model compresses geometry and texture into a unified sparse latent representation via VAE, then uses a DiT to generate assets matching reference images, supported by an agile evaluation and data engine iteration pipeline. It is available through the Hunyuan 3D creation engine and Tencent Cloud API.

原文标题：腾讯混元发布 Hy3D 3.6 3D 生成大模型

item.title: Embodied AI Firms Shift R&D Focus to Low-Level Motion Control
item.description:
At a roundtable during BAAI's REAL Physical AI Open Day, founders from leading embodied AI startups including Spirit AI, Galbot, Galaxea, and Robot Era agreed that as general-purpose models like GPT-6 Astra and Claude Fable 5.2 outperform specialized robot models in task planning (System 2), embodied firms should redirect R&D priority toward motion control and skill execution (System 0/1). Galbot's Wang He noted that pure agent methods can score high on simulation benchmarks but still face hard gaps in on-device deployment and real physical execution. Founders also warned of cooling capital and a narrowing startup window.

原文标题：具身智能公司集体转向 优先投入底层运控

Why it matters：头部具身智能公司集体调整技术路线，反映通用大模型对机器人行业的实质冲击，对判断行业走向有参考价值。

item.title: Free Electronics 101 Site Offers 68 Interactive 3D Lessons
item.description:

item.title: Microsoft Study Finds AI Coding Patches 2.33x Larger Than Human Fixes
item.description:
A new Microsoft paper replayed 7,660 GitHub Copilot CLI runs across 18 models, traced each patch block to its originating step, and re-ran tests to grade necessity. Agent patches touch 2.33x more lines than human fixes, but the surplus is mostly tests and documentation rather than redundant code. On SWE-bench Verified, 88.7% of agent code blocks were needed versus 86.4% for developers, suggesting over-editing stems from the fix itself, not debug leftovers; the authors urge reporting needed-code share alongside resolve rate.

原文标题：微软新研究揭示 AI 编程补丁体积达人类 2.33 倍

Why it matters：首次用逐块溯源与重跑测试的方法量化 AI 补丁“体积大但必要”的现象，为编程智能体评测提供了新指标。

item.title: Aschenbrenner's AI Hedge Fund Sheds 65% in Third Quarter
item.description:
Situational Awareness, the AI-focused hedge fund founded by Leopold Aschenbrenner, told investors it lost 65% after fees in Q3 2026, with most of the damage in July when a brief AI panic triggered bank margin calls on its leveraged bets. The fund sold the bulk of its public stocks to Ken Griffin's Citadel at a discount to raise cash, cutting its 2026 gain to 88.5% through September from a reported 439% through June.

原文标题：Aschenbrenner 旗下 AI 对冲基金三季度回撤 65%

Why it matters：这是 AI 主题投资高杠杆风险的一次标志性回撤案例，对判断 AI 资本市场情绪具有参考价值。

item.title: Sqrin Brings Smart Auto Zoom and Pointer Enhancement to Mac Screen Sharing
item.description:

Version 1.2.8 adds an on-device Auto Zoom that decides when and where to zoom based on pointer movement and UI interactions, with no cloud AI involved.

item.title: Study Puts AI Bubble Burst Probability at 97 Percent
item.description:
A London Business School study builds a media-warning indicator from 170 years of financial journalism and estimates up to a 97 percent probability that markets were in an AI bubble as of September 2026, urging investors and executives to prepare for a potential crash. The finding rests on quantified analysis of press bubble narratives rather than a direct assessment of AI industry fundamentals.

item.title: Terence Tao Warns AI-Generated Math Proofs Risk Becoming Nuclear Waste
item.description:
Speaking at a Harvard event, Terence Tao said AI companies mass-produce hard-to-digest math proofs to benchmark models, likening the output to nuclear waste from power plants, and urged firms to co-select problems with mathematicians. He is himself following and interpreting the newly announced Riemann Hypothesis proof, launched a public collaboration on his blog to digest it, and said he has handed Python, JavaScript and literature search to AI while keeping independent mathematical reasoning for himself.

原文标题：陶哲轩谈 AI 数学证明：批量产出如同核废料

Why it matters：顶尖数学家对 AI 生成数学证明质量与生态影响的一手判断，兼具观点价值与行业信号。

item.title: China Statistics Bureau Says AI Data Center Buildout Lifts Fiber Optic Profits 6.7x
item.description:
China's National Bureau of Statistics reported that large-scale AI data center construction drove profits in fiber optic and optical cable manufacturing up 6.7x and 1.5x respectively for January-October. The electronics sector's profits doubled year-on-year, contributing 9.7 percentage points to overall industrial profit growth, with AI compute demand also lifting memory chips and base metals like copper and aluminum.

原文标题：国家统计局：智算中心建设带动光纤制造利润增长 6.7 倍

Why it matters：官方宏观数据首次量化智算中心建设对光纤光缆、电子与有色金属产业链的利润拉动，是观察 AI 算力投资外溢效应的硬指标。

item.title: Amazon Paper Finds Self-Revised Agent Harnesses Barely Generalize
item.description:
A new Amazon paper finds that frontier models can build their own agent harnesses from scratch, but self-revisions yield little on unseen tasks. Across 9 model setups with 3 builds and 2 self-revisions each, practice-game scores rose 8.42 points while unseen-game gains were only 2.80, too uncertain to rule out zero. In 9 of 27 runs, cheaper versions also scored worse.

原文标题：亚马逊论文揭示智能体自改框架泛化增益微弱

Why it matters：首次系统量化智能体自我改写框架的泛化边界，对自动化智能体工程实践有直接警示价值。

item.title: Twenty AI Agents Team Up to Cut Quickwit Query Time by 31%
item.description:
TabbyML assembled 20 AI agents into an autonomous engineering team that optimized the open-source search engine Quickwit without being told which code to change, handling bottleneck discovery, solution design and peer code review on its own. In four days the team ran roughly 350 experiments and kept 6 reviewed optimizations, cutting total hot-query time on a 100M-row dataset from 40.5s to 27.9s, with some queries dropping 87%, and surpassing all prior public results in the ClickBench data-lake hot-query category.

原文标题：20 个 AI Agents 组队 4 天优化 Quickwit 查询降 31%

Why it matters：这是多智能体自主完成真实系统性能优化的完整闭环案例，含可验证基准与量化收益，对关注 Agent 工程化落地的读者价值高。
